_comment: Registry of NADIA members used by scripts/fetch_publications.py to find new papers.
name          Display name (informational only; not used for matching).
orcid         ORCID iD, e.g. '0000-0002-1234-5678'. This is the reliable
matcher. Papers found via ORCID are eligible for auto-commit;
papers found only by name always go to a review PR.
name_variants Author-name spellings to search when orcid is null. ADS format
is 'Surname, F.' — include the variants that actually appear on
joined        First day of NADIA membership (YYYY-MM-DD). Papers published
left          Last day of membership (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if still active.
Papers published after this date are ignored.
